description: A non-DEFAULT delivery mode overrides the bind service type for one U_PDU, and DEFAULT (Transmission Mode 0) uses the bind service type and ignores its other subfields, as group-address acceptance shows.
note: ARQ to a group is refused (S-0138), so whether a group request is accepted shows which mode applied. Accepted non-ARQ requests go to the DTS queue, which has no observable effect until the planner (P3-4); a burst_started first keeps the channel busy, so a CSMA MAC holds in SENSE (K-0066) and the trace stays valid once Annex K lands. Since corpus 0.7.0 the DTS also keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue: started when a request becomes the earliest, cancelled when the transmit queue empties (C-1050).
